# Photo Scraper & Hero Image Logic Requirements Quality Checklist: Unified POI Import Staging Workbench

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of requirements for hero photo discovery, official website OpenGraph/Twitter card scraping, Wikimedia Commons image resolution, and uncropped workbench photo preview  
**Created**: 2026-11-02  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)  

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.  

---

## 1. Hero Image Discovery & Scraping Precedence Requirements

- [x] CHK001 - Is the authoritative precedence order between Wikipedia/Wikimedia image claims (P18) and official website meta tags unambiguously specified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK002 - Are extraction requirements explicitly defined for `<meta property="og:image">` and `<meta name="twitter:image">` tags on scraped official websites? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 - Does the specification define fallback behavior when an official website meta image tag specifies a relative path (e.g., `/images/hero.jpg`) versus an absolute URL? [Edge Case, Clarity, Gap]
- [x] CHK004 - Are fuzzy Wikipedia title matching requirements (using `redirects=1` and `action=query&generator=search`) explicitly mandated for alternate POI titles (e.g. 'Caerleon Roman Legion Museum' matching 'National Roman Legion Museum')? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Gap]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the handling of Wikimedia Commons licensing, attribution, and direct uncompressed media URL resolution unambiguously defined? [Completeness, Gap]

---

## 2. Image URL Validation & Security Requirements

- [x] CHK006 - Are supported image MIME types (`image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`) explicitly enumerated for discovered hero images? [Clarity, Gap]
- [x] CHK007 - Does the specification enforce HTTPS scheme normalization for all scraped image URLs before storage? [Security, Consistency, Gap]
- [x] CHK008 - Are minimum dimension or resolution thresholds (e.g. width $\ge 600\text{px}$) specified to prevent low-resolution icon/thumbnail capture? [Quality, Measurability, Gap]
- [x] CHK009 - Are URL timeout and redirect-following ceilings (e.g. max 3 hops, 5.0s timeout) explicitly specified for scraping external photo headers? [Non-Functional, Constraints, Gap]

---

## 3. Workbench UI Presentation & Preview Requirements

- [x] CHK010 - Is the candidate table hero photo thumbnail presentation requirement defined with specific fallback icon styling when a photo is missing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the "uncropped preview" in the right-hand candidate editor quantified with specific aspect ratio, containment, and maximum display height rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §User Story 1]
- [x] CHK012 - Are visual warning indicators explicitly required on the candidate row when `disposition == Accept` and `hero_image_url` is empty? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK013 - Does the specification require immediate client-side preview re-rendering when a user manually updates the hero image URL input field? [Interaction Flow, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK014 - Is error state handling specified when a user enters an invalid or unreachable image URL in the editor? [Edge Case, Exception Flow, Gap]

---

## 4. Targeted & Batch Photo Enrichment Requirements

- [x] CHK015 - When the user clicks "AI Enrich POI", is the photo scraper required to preserve an existing user-supplied `hero_image_url` and only scrape when the field is blank? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the maximum latency for single-POI photo scraping and enrichment quantified with an objective threshold ($< 3.5\text{s}$)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK017 - When running asynchronous bulk "AI Enrich All", are rate limits and politeness delays explicitly mandated for outbound HTTP requests to official websites? [Constraints, Spec §FR-030]
- [x] CHK018 - Does the specification define whether photo scraper results are persisted in a local cache (e.g. SHA-256 of domain or URL) to avoid repeated outbound downloads across re-scans? [Performance, Gap]

---

## 5. Traceability, Data Model & Commit Requirements

- [x] CHK019 - Is `hero_image_url` explicitly mapped from `IngestCandidate` to the permanent PostGIS `pois.hero_image_url` and `pois.image_urls` array upon commit? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK020 - Does the specification require inclusion of the `hero_image_url` in the exported CSV when using "Export Selected"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the custom User-Agent header (`VistaraeTravelEngine/1.0`) mandated for all outbound photo scraping HTTP requests? [Compliance, Constraints, Spec §Assumptions A-002]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked (`[ ]`) when they require clarification, specification updates, or reviewer evaluation.
- Items tagged with `[Gap]` indicate requirements identified as missing or underspecified in the current `spec.md`.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a review gate and must not modify markers.
- Numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK021) for granular traceability across reviews.
